VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Descripti: System configuration overlay for signing in. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by the ConfigLoader, so read every value through StateManager.VghLantern__StateManager__GetAppConfig() rather than fetching this file directly. Since 15-Oct-2026 Lantern Designer signs in with the shared Vale sign-in (/AppAssets__CommonApplicationAssets/Shared__UserLogin/, the same account and password as ValeVision and ValeVision 3D, one session for every Vale app). The prototype's test accounts, cookie and sign-in copy are retired; the shared card owns its own wording. This file keeps the Lantern logo for the card and the labels of the app's own items in the avatar menu.

VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Content.LogoPathNote: Shown at the top of the shared sign-in card, so Lantern Designer's card keeps its own artwork.

VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.AccountMenuNote: The avatar, the identity block, Change password and Sign out are drawn by the shared sign-in. These are the items Lantern Designer adds to that menu.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.HomeScreenNote: Returns to the landing card from any mode. The loaded project is left untouched, so leaving the landing screen again lands back on the same drawing.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperMenuNote: Shown to AppAdmin accounts only (the shared sign-in's adminOnly), as ValeVision 3D's Dev Tools are. Was the Developer role of the prototype's test accounts.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperSketchUpNote: Writes the current lantern as a millimetre build payload for the Vale Lantern Importer in SketchUp. The lantern exported is always the one on screen.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperCadNote: Writes the current lantern's plan and elevations as one layered DXF. Not yet built - the menu item reports that rather than failing silently.
